correctness.rationale: Faithfulness injects J into Hom(M/W,U) with U=JM contained in W=Ann_M(J). In dimension at most 2s−1 the product of the two dimensions is at most s(s−1)<s²−1. In dimension 2s it follows that U=W and the two dimensions are s+d,s−d with d²≤1. Conversely all frames in these profiles work: full rectangular Hom has spanning images and trivial common kernel, and every balanced hyperplane contains an invertible matrix. For the latter, left/right equivalence puts the trace normal in diagonal rank normal form, so a cyclic permutation matrix with no diagonal entries supplies an invertible member in every characteristic. A module isomorphism preserves U and transforms its specified J-frame by the left/right base-change group; its splitting shear acts trivially. The full rectangular matrix units force pointwise stabilizers to be common scalars. For a balanced hyperplane use an invertible X₀ to identify the two square blocks; their compatibility then makes one block centralize the hyperplane HX₀⁻¹. For a nonscalar operator P there is a vector v independent of Pv, since an operator preserving every line is scalar over every field. The values of a commuting matrix on a basis containing v,Pv have one vector of values determined by the other, so the centralizer dimension is at most s²−s and cannot contain a hyperplane. Thus the stabilizer is again the group of common nonzero scalars. Counting frames gives g_r per hyperplane, with exactly R_{s,t}/(q−1) hyperplanes of rank-t normal; orbit-stabilizer gives the claimed formulas. The same pointwise argument for noninvertible diagonal blocks proves the endomorphism ring formula, since commuting with radical action forces the lower-left block to vanish and leaves the upper-right block arbitrary. The radical of this commutative local ring is exactly the square-zero upper-right space. Substitution gives totals 72 and 392 at s=2, q=2 and 3 respectively, with stated strata.
residual_risks: The reported small-field exhaustions and larger formula evaluations are corroboration only; the general conclusions are proved by linear algebra. The fixed-algebra equivalence is essential.

value.rationale: Defect one from the maximum possible radical dimension at representation degree 2s is a canonical near-extremal regime, in which exactly two full rectangular spaces and a balanced hyperplane locus compete. The marked orbit census distinguishes precisely the cases not resolved by the degree bound or a representation-space dimension count, and the represented-algebra versus commutant distinction is a natural structural invariant. These formulas answer a fixed-algebra classification question at every finite field, including characteristic two, rather than recompute a particular small-dimensional example.
residual_risks: No classification of higher-dimensional faithful modules or nonsplit algebras follows; source-algebra automorphism orbits are a different question.
